projecthero.hideout.alarm.gravebound: A cursed grave stirs: the dead claw their way up!
projecthero.hideout.alarm.oathbreaker: A war horn sounds from the keep!
projecthero.hideout.crypt_curse: The Crypt Curse takes hold: your strength drains away.
item.projecthero.gravecaller_bell.toolti: Ring it (use): every undead within 16 blocks is shaken - slowed, weakened and made to forget you for 6 seconds - and other hostiles flinch. 40 second cooldown.
item.projecthero.brood_fang.tooltip: A fast blade that feeds: every hit withers the target for 2 seconds and heals you 1 health.
item.projecthero.oath_sigil.tooltip: Swear the oath (use): Resistance II and Strength for 8 seconds. 60 second cooldown.
projecthero.jei.oath_ballista: The Oathbreaker Keep's wall engines. Once the keep is on its guard (its alarm is Suspicious or Alert) a ballista looses a heavy bolt every 3 seconds at the nearest player in front of it within 28 blocks, in sight. Sneak past unseen and the crews never man them. An axe breaks one.
projecthero.jei.crimson_biomass: Carnage's red symbiote biomass and its pulsing egg sacs, grown over the Carnage Nest. The biomass is sticky to walk on.
projecthero.guide.hideouts.body: Eight villain factions each run a hideout somewhere in the world: Tier 3 places, rarer than the old sites and far more dangerous. Each one is a 10-15 minute crawl over several levels, with guards that never despawn, alarms, traps, a Captain with the keycard and a mini-boss guarding the faction's Hideout Core. A Hideout Locator (from Site Vaults) points to the nearest one.
projecthero.guide.hideouts.calm.body: A cleared hideout calms its faction for five in-game days within 512 blocks of it: that faction's raids and events can't start there (Syndicate Busts and street crimes, Ultron Uprisings, Apokolips Invasions, Frost Giant Assaults, Carnage's meteor for the Symbiote Hive and the Carnage Nest, Zombie Raids and Cursed Zombies for the Gravebound Crypt, Oath-bound night patrols for the Oathbreaker Keep). Operator commands still work.
projecthero.guide.hideouts.mini_bosses.b: Every mini-boss has a boss bar, turns on whoever is hurting it most, and gets a second phase at half health (the bar turns red) with a new attack: the Enforcer's Bull Rush, the Overseer's Plasma Mines, the Commander's Firebomb Run, the Hive Mother's Biomass Eruption, the Jarl's Ice Spike line and blizzard, the Crypt Lord's Requiem rings, the Brood Spawn's Bloodbath spikes and the Champion's Judgement Blades. They always drop Vibranium Shards, with a 1 in 4 chance of a Dungeon Locator.
projecthero.guide.hideouts.traps.body: Laser tripwires, sweeping cameras and tripwires hooked to the faction's alarm (siren boxes, egg pods, war horns, cursed headstones) raise the alarm when you set them off; sabotage the panel they are wired to and they go dead. A cursed headstone also lays the Crypt Curse on everyone near it (Wither, Darkness, Slowness). Some floors hide pressure plates that fire arrows from the walls, and vents that hiss for a moment, then erupt: step off fast. The Oathbreaker Keep's ballistae open fire once the keep is on its guard.
A fenced graveyard of crooked headstones and open graves round a ruined chapel, with a sniper in the bell tower and a cursed headstone across the path. The stair in the chapel aisle drops to an ossuary of bone niches, sarcophagi and soul-fire vents (one side tomb holds a Cursed Zombie: its touch is the real Gravebound Curse), then down again to the Lord's Barrow. Mini-boss: the Crypt Lord, a dead king who reaps with soul fire, drags you down with grasping hands, throws soul bolts and raises the dead.
projecthero.guide.hideouts.h.carnage.bod: An old crimson-meteor crater where a quarantine field station was overrun: a guard post with the first panel and cameras, an eaten lab module, a watchtower sniper and floodlights round a bowl crawling with red biomass. A breach in the meteor leads down into a hatchery of pulsing egg walls and biomass vents, and below it the overgrown containment labs. Mini-boss: the Brood Spawn of Carnage, which bursts spikes out of the floor, lobs goo, snares, pounces and pours out Carnage's brood. Fire hurts it more.
projecthero.guide.hideouts.h.oathbreaker: A ruined fortress cut into a mountainside: curtain walls with wall-walks, four towers and a gatehouse, all with Oath Ballistae that fire once the keep is on its guard. A courtyard of straw dummies, barracks and a broken oath shrine leads to the keep: the great hall (the first panel), an armoury above, and the stair down to the undercroft. Mini-boss: the Oathbound Champion, a giant knight with a three-cut combo, a Shield Charge, a soul-fire Oath Slam and a Rally that empowers his knights.
projecthero.guide.hideouts.a.gravebound: Gravecaller Bell: ring it to shake every undead nearby - slowed, weakened and made to forget you.
projecthero.guide.hideouts.a.carnage: Brood Fang: a fast blade whose hits wither the target and heal you.
projecthero.guide.hideouts.a.oathbreaker: Champion's Oath Sigil: swear the oath for 8 seconds of Resistance II and Strength.
